paragraphs.text: A lot of things went our way.
A lot of things went our way. We got very timely dice, and the rolls felt maxed out, even though we actually rolled the fewest cards. The real difference was the efficiency of our development cards.

Doing that while playing coastal port and drawing no victory points was not easy. I first thought we might have had a Monopoly, then corrected myself: we pulled a Year of Plenty, a Road Building card, and, I think, only knights.
uncertainties: Whether the remaining development cards were all knights.

paragraphs.text: We had seven development cards total: five knights, a Year of Plenty, and a Road Building card.
I think this was a perfect example of killer efficiency, though we were also very lucky with the dice and how the endgame played out.
We're making good strides on our way back to number one.
